sources.name: Brawl Time Ninja
sources.usedFor: Gadget and star power win rates among players who own only one of that item (the official API does not record equipped kits). Published list season 2026-11-09 (26 Oct–9 Nov 2026), last updated 12 Nov 2026 around 03:43 UTC. Sample: about 4.26 million gadget picks and 4.12 million star-power picks.

sources.name: Noff.gg
sources.usedFor: Per-brawler gear pick rates, and a cross-check of gadget and star power, from each “Best … Build (November 2026)” page (community-submitted builds, 22–852 per brawler).

notes: Names and ids match the official Brawl Stars API /brawlers catalog. Gadget and star power: use the item both sources name; if they disagree, take Brawl Time Ninja when its win-rate lead is at least 2 percentage points and that option has at least 5,000 picks and 35% of the two-option sample (avoids crowning a small-sample spike); otherwise take Noff when it has at least 20 builds and a 55%+ pick rate (or 30 builds and 52%+). If Noff still lists a retired gadget name after a rework (e.g. Lou, Chester), the official/Brawl Time Ninja name is used. Gears come from Noff, because Brawl Time Ninja’s public gear tier list is not broken down per brawler. Thunder Frogs, Rey and Ruby are upcoming and have no published competitive builds yet. This file is a curated snapshot, not refreshed by the daily job (Brawl Time Ninja asks for a key for automated project access).
